{{Top|leg}}
'''Reifflex cellular padding''' was a material used in the [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor of Darth Vader]]. It was also implemented in the base of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmets]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] by the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] at the earliest, as well as the interior of the standard-issue [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmets]] for [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilots in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] since at least the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
It is named for [[Chris Reiff]], who provided artwork for ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''. The material itself was likewise based on a set of obscure blueprints that came with a stormtrooper [[Riddell mini-helmet]] and Luke's flight helmet from the same series.<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2011/09/5-things-you-didnt-know-about-darth.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=5 Things You Didn't Know About Darth Vader}}</ref>
